title: Aunque llueva o truene: concesión fáctica frente a hipótesis
goal: Differentiate and employ 'aunque' with indicative vs. subjunctive to contrast verifiable obstacles with hypothetical or discounted objections.
grammar: Oraciones concesivas con aunque: contraste fáctico vs hipótesis

sections.title: Unit 8: Concession & Counter-Argument — Lesson 1
body: Welcome to lesson 1 of Unit 8 (Concession & Counter-Argument). Mastering concessive nuances is fundamental for advanced debate, academic writing, and diplomatic discourse in Spanish.
In this lesson, we examine aunque llueva o truene: concesión fáctica frente a hipótesis, calibrating indicative vs. subjunctive triggers to construct persuasive counter-arguments.

items: Differentiate and employ 'aunque' with indicative vs. subjunctive to contrast verifiable obstacles with hypothetical or discounted objections.
Incorporate upper-intermediate debate lexicon (la objeción, irrefutable).
